method: Hierarchical clustering (average linkage / UPGMA) of the 46 indicator score series over all quarters, using correlation distance (1 - Pearson r) on pairwise-complete observations (>= 24 common quarters required). Row order is deterministic: distances are rounded to 12 decimals and merge ties break by smallest leaf index.
